title: Senior Product Analyst II [T500-29940]
description:
**About Us:**

**Marriott International Inc.**
, headquartered in Bethesda, Maryland, USA, was founded in May 1927 by J. Willard Marriott and Alice S. Marriott with a modest nine-seat A&W root beer stand. Guided by the family's leadership and core principles, Marriott International today has grown into a global hospitality giant, operating approximately 9,000 properties and over 30 leading brands in more than 140 countries and territories.

From such humble beginnings to becoming the world’s largest hotel company, Marriott International has never stopped searching for inventive ways to serve its customers, provide opportunities for its associates, and grow their business. At
**Marriott Tech Accelerator center**
(MTA), Hyderabad, India, Marriott is exploring the world we live in and all its possibilities. At Marriott Tech Accelerator, we are a team of passionate engineering minds dedicated to creating and building cutting-edge solutions that streamline operations and elevate guest experiences.

Marriott Tech Accelerator is an ANSR entity incorporated exclusively for providing services to Marriott International.

**Role Title:**
Senior Product Analyst II

**Experience:**
6+ Years

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**JOB SUMMARY:**

The MTA Senior Product Analyst II provides business analysis, planning, transformation, and delivery support to US-based GIS stakeholders and globally distributed technology teams. The role studies business objectives, stakeholder needs, operating processes, and technology requirements; documents clear, actionable requirements; and supports delivery of cybersecurity and Identity & Access Management initiatives.

Success in this role requires the ability to analyze complex information, translate business needs into well-defined requirements, communicate findings in an actionable manner, and coordinate multiple priorities across time zones. The ideal candidate is self-motivated, organized, detail-oriented, and effective in a global delivery model, with the judgment to work independently while escalating risks, dependencies, and decisions appropriately.

**CANDIDATE PROFILE:**

**Education and Experience:**

**Required:**

* Bachelor's degree, equivalent experience, and/or relevant professional certification.
* 6+ years of experience in IT business analysis, requirements management, process improvement, project coordination, organizational change, strategic communications, performance management, or a related discipline.
* Experience eliciting, analyzing, documenting, validating, and managing business, functional, and non-functional requirements.
* Experience developing process flows, user stories, acceptance criteria, traceability documentation, status reports, dashboards, and executive-ready presentations.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities through effective planning, organization, time management, and timely follow-through.
* Project coordination skills, including maintaining milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, decisions, and action items and proactively escalating roadblocks.
* Excellent data gathering, analysis, problem-solving, written communication, and verbal communication skills.
* Excellent PowerPoint and presentation skills.
* Experience using tools such as Jira, Confluence, ServiceNow, and Microsoft Office – PowerPoint and excel. Documentation, high level interpersonal skills.

**Preferred:**

* Business Analysis, Agile, Scrum, SAFe, PMP, or related certification.
* Experience in information security, Identity & Access Management, IGA, RBAC, SailPoint, IT risk management, cybersecurity operations, or a similar technology environment.
* Ability to place information security risks, requirements, and delivery impacts in the proper business context and communicate the business relevance to decision makers.
* Experience supporting Program Increment planning, governance, product backlogs, release readiness, and cross-team dependency management.
* Experience collaborating with US-based stakeholders and India-based delivery teams, including reasonable overlap with US Eastern Time business hours.

**CORE WORK ACTIVITIES:**

* Elicits, analyses, documents, validates, and manages business, functional, and non-functional requirements for GIS initiatives.
* Develops process flows, user stories, acceptance criteria, traceability documentation, business rules, and clear success measures.
* Collects, validates, and analyses delivery and performance data; identifies trends, risks, systemic issues, and data-quality gaps.
* Creates dashboards, reports, presentations, decision summaries, and executive-ready materials for project, governance, and leadership meetings.
* Partners with Product Owners, Program Leaders, technical leads, engineers, testers, and business stakeholders to clarify needs and support delivery decisions.
* Supports PI Planning, backlog refinement, sprint readiness, release readiness, and cross-team dependency coordination.
* Maintains visibility into milestones, requirements, risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, action items, and resource considerations.
* Analyzes system functionality and business processes, identifies gaps, and recommends practical improvements.
* Coordinates smaller workstreams or projects and supports timely handoffs and follow-up across US and MTA teams.
* Composes and maintains requirements documents, operating procedures, process documentation, reports, correspondence, and meeting records.
* Clearly communicates technical and information security concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Adapts to a fast-paced, ambiguous, and event-driven environment while maintaining accountability for assigned deliverables.

**Maintaining Goals:**

* Submits requirements, reports, analysis, and requested materials in a timely manner, ensuring delivery deadlines are met.
* Promotes accurate documentation of project progress, requirements, decisions, risks, and action items.
* Provides input and assistance to other teams regarding analysis, reporting, planning, and delivery activities.

**Managing Work, Projects, and Policies:**

* Manages and implements assigned analysis and project coordination activities in alignment with Marriott standards and team practices.
* Generates accurate and timely results in the form of requirements, reports, presentations, dashboards, and process documentation.
* Analyzes information and evaluates options to recommend practical solutions and resolve delivery problems.
* Provides timely, accurate, and detailed status reporting as requested.

**Demonstrating and Applying Discipline Knowledge:**

* Demonstrates knowledge of business analysis, requirements management, process improvement, Agile delivery, and the technology delivery lifecycle.
* Demonstrates familiarity with cybersecurity and Identity & Access Management concepts, tools, and governance expectations.
* Keeps current on business analysis practices, relevant technologies, Marriott delivery standards, and applicable tools.
* Uses computer systems and collaboration tools effectively to enter, track, analyze, and communicate information.

**Delivering on the Needs of Key Stakeholders:**

* Understands stakeholder priorities and translates them into clear requirements, analysis, delivery actions, and follow-up.
* Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish assigned work.
* Determines priorities, schedules, plans, and necessary resources to support completion of assigned initiatives.
* Collaborates with internal partners and stakeholders to support product, platform, cybersecurity, and business strategies.
* Communicates concepts, findings, risks, and recommendations clearly and persuasively for technical and non-technical audiences.
* Demonstrates an understanding of business priorities and the importance of secure, reliable technology outcomes.

**Education and Certifications:**

* Undergraduate degree or equivalent experience/certification

**Work location:**
Hyderabad, India.

**Work mode:**
Hybrid

title: Senior Analyst - Research and Insights - Strategy & Operations - Hyderabad
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Research and Insights: Strategy and Operations – Senior Analyst**
The Senior Analyst– Research & Insights (R&I) Strategy & Operations role plays a critical execution and enablement role across strategy, operations, analytics, and delivery within Research & Insights. The Strategy & Operations (S&O) team operates across four core pillars—R&I Transformation & Strategy, Business Intelligence & Impact, Audience Growth & Activation, and Delivery Excellence. This role will address elements of each, largely in support of our Global Deloitte Insights (DI) organization.
  
  
The role will support our Global Deloitte Insights and Research and insights team with project management, thought leadership activation, stakeholder engagement, transformation initiatives, and reporting and operational support on projects. The candidate will work closely with senior leaders in Global DI and Research and Insights group to build and work on projects that have a direct impact on business priorities and strategy. A candidate with experience in working with senior executives across project management, process optimization, operations management, and reporting, will be preferred.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Research and Insights: Strategy and Operations – Senior Analyst on the Strategy & Operations (S&O) team, you will be responsible for…
  
  
Support leadership in executing strategic priorities, business objectives, and transformation initiatives.
  
  
Plan, coordinate, and manage projects and operational initiatives, including scope, timelines, dependencies, governance activities, stakeholder communications, and deliverables.
  
  
Analyze and synthesize data; define, track, and report key performance indicators (KPIs) and business metrics; and develop dashboards, pipeline reports, impact reports, and performance scorecards.
  
  
Identify and implement automation for reporting and operational processes using Microsoft Excel, Power Query, Power BI, Power Automate, and selected generative artificial intelligence (AI) platforms.
  
  
Develop presentations, reports, newsletters, and communications; maintain thought-leadership platforms and content repositories; and support knowledge sharing, process improvement, and cross-functional delivery.
  
  
**The team**
The Strategy & Operations (S&O) team sits within Research & Insights (R&I) team. We operate across four core pillars—R&I Transformation & Strategy, Business Intelligence & Impact, Audience Growth & Activation, and Delivery Excellence, driving R&I strategic direction.
  
  
**Location: Hyderabad**
**Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM**
**Qualifications**
**Required:**
Master’s degree
  
  
3+ years of experience in strategy, operations, analytics, reporting, or program management
  
  
**Preferred:**
Master of Business Administration (MBA) degree
  
  
Experience managing projects or operational initiatives, including scope, timelines, dependencies, and deliverables
  
  
Experience using Microsoft Excel and Microsoft PowerPoint to develop analyses, reports, or presentations
  
  
Experience using Microsoft Power BI or Tableau to develop dashboards, performance reports, or scorecards
  
  
Experience using Microsoft Power Query or Microsoft Power Automate to automate reporting or operational processes
  
  
Experience maintaining SharePoint sites, content repositories, or collaboration platforms
  
  
**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: Product Expert - Web CMS - Drupal
description:

As Web Experience and Operations Lead, you will have an excellent opportunity to be at the forefront of Novartis Next Generation Customer Engagement transformation. You will be accountable for delivering outstanding and consistent web experiences you will work with marketing, medical, digital and technology teams to define and bring to life a data-driven and performance-optimized web strategy for international markets.

Location: Hyderabad #Hybrid

Strategic Web Experience Leadership

* Champion best practices in user experience (UX), content governance, accessibility, and web performance to deliver consistent, high-quality digital experiences across markets.

Demand Management

* Proven ability to manage demand intake, prioritize business requirements, and translate needs into scalable solutions.
* Strong understanding of Agile product delivery methodologies.
* Demonstrated experience working with senior stakeholders and leading strategic business discussions.
* Proactive, ownership-driven mindset with the ability to independently drive outcomes and resolve challenges.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to simplify complex concepts and communicate them effectively to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong collaboration skills with experience working across cross-functional and global teams.

**Desirable Requirements**

* Experience supporting global web platforms across multiple regions and markets.
* Exposure to web governance, content operations, and enterprise digital transformation initiatives.
* Knowledge of release management, UAT frameworks, and quality assurance best practices.
* Experience facilitating stakeholder workshops, product demonstrations, and panel discussions.
* Familiarity with data-driven decision-making and digital analytics reporting.
* Experience building scalable web solutions while balancing business, compliance, and technical considerations.
* Natural curiosity, continuous improvement mindset, and ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority.

Helping people with disease and their families takes more than innovative science. It takes a community of smart, passionate people like you. Collaborating, supporting and inspiring each other. Combining to achieve breakthroughs that change patients’ lives. Ready to create a brighter future together? https://www.novartis.com/about/strategy/people-and-culture

title: Senior Analyst - Transformation - Consulting Product Analyst
description:
**General Position Information**
Reports directly to (Title): Director or Senior Director, HR Transformation & Analytics
  
  
Matrix reports to (Title): -
  
  
Direct Reports: Individual contributor
  
  
Created / Last Revised: -
  
  
Job Code: -
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Senior Analyst - Transformation provides advanced, cross-functional advisory leadership for HR Transformation & Analytics. This role is used for complex, ambiguous, or enterprise-impacting work that requires deep functional expertise, strong stakeholder influence, standards-setting, and the ability to connect business outcomes, data, technology, process, product, and AI-readiness considerations across multiple teams or portfolios.
  
  
The Senior Analyst - Transformation supports HR Transformation & Analytics by measuring how HR products, tools, portals, workflows, automations, and analytics experiences are used and whether they deliver intended outcomes. This role partners with product owners, business analysts, BI developers, data analysts, change managers, and HR stakeholders to track adoption, usage, feature effectiveness, user friction, and value realization.
  
  
The role is responsible for product performance reporting, usage analysis, funnel analysis, experiment measurement, dashboard requirements, and product insight generation. Success requires product thinking, analytical discipline, stakeholder communication, and responsible use of AI-enabled product analytics tools.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Consulting-Level Advisory & Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Serve as a trusted advisor on complex HR Transformation & Analytics initiatives that span multiple stakeholders, systems, functions, or business outcomes.
* Shape solution direction, operating approach, delivery standards, analytical methods, technical patterns, or governance practices for assigned areas of expertise.
* Lead complex discovery, problem framing, impact analysis, stakeholder alignment, and recommendation development where ownership or solution paths are not yet clear.
* Influence leaders and cross-functional partners through structured analysis, executive-ready communication, trade-off framing, and practical implementation recommendations.
* Establish reusable practices, playbooks, quality standards, templates, and decision frameworks that improve consistency and maturity across the HR Transformation & Analytics organization.

**Product Usage & Adoption Analytics**

* Track product adoption, active usage, feature utilization, completion rates, drop-offs, engagement patterns, and user segments.
* Analyze user journeys, friction points, workflow bottlenecks, and behavior patterns across HR digital products and analytics experiences.
* Develop product performance summaries that help teams understand what is working, what is not, and what should be improved.

**Measurement, Experimentation & Value Tracking**

* Support product KPI definitions, success measures, baselines, adoption targets, and post-release performance tracking.
* Analyze pilots, releases, experiments, enhancements, and process changes to determine impact and value delivered.
* Partner with product owners and analysts to translate findings into roadmap recommendations and prioritization inputs.

**Dashboard, Data & Stakeholder Partnership**

* Define analytics requirements for product dashboards, event tracking, data capture, and reporting views.
* Validate product data, document definitions, and identify gaps in telemetry, source systems, or user feedback.
* Communicate insights to product, transformation, operations, change, and leadership stakeholders in a clear and action-oriented manner.

**AI-Augmented Product Analytics**

* Use approved AI tools to support feedback clustering, insight drafting, product question framing, experiment summaries, and user behavior hypotheses.
* Validate AI-assisted findings against product data, user feedback, and business context before making recommendations.
* Identify opportunities to embed AI-assisted insight, self-service analytics, or intelligent product experiences into HR products.

**AI Preparedness Expectations**

* Shapes responsible AI adoption patterns for assigned domains, including appropriate use cases, controls, human review expectations, validation approaches, and stakeholder readiness.
* Advises leaders and cross-functional partners on how AI can improve productivity, insight generation, engineering, analytics delivery, process maturity, product outcomes, and workforce readiness.
* Establishes or contributes to reusable AI guidance, prompt patterns, quality checks, governance artifacts, and adoption practices that reduce risk and improve consistency.
* Builds advanced capability in AI-enabled operating models, responsible AI governance, AI-assisted analytics and engineering, and future-of-work implications over the next three years.
* Uses AI to accelerate feedback synthesis, insight generation, journey analysis, and recommendation drafting while validating against product evidence.
* Understands AI-enabled product analytics, privacy limits, and the need for transparent measurement definitions.
* Builds capability in augmented product analytics, experimentation, behavioral analytics, AI-assisted user research, and intelligent HR product measurement over the next three years.

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Human Resources, Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Statistics, Engineering, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered.
* Typically 5+ years of experience in a related environment.
* Experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives, advisory engagements, enterprise analytics, technology delivery, transformation workstreams, or process improvement efforts.
* Experience influencing leaders, resolving ambiguity, framing decisions, and presenting recommendations to senior managers, directors, or senior directors.
* Experience establishing standards, governance practices, reusable frameworks, playbooks, or capability maturity improvements across teams or portfolios.
* Experience with product analytics, business analytics, reporting, user behavior analysis, process analytics, HR technology, or digital product support.
* Experience analyzing adoption, usage, workflow, operational, or customer/user experience data.
* Experience creating product performance reports, dashboards, summaries, or recommendations for product or business stakeholders.

**Must Have Skills**

* Advanced advisory capability with the ability to frame ambiguous problems, assess trade-offs, and recommend practical enterprise or cross-functional solutions.
* Strong executive communication skills, including the ability to convert complex analysis, process, technology, product, or data issues into clear decisions and actions.
* Demonstrated ability to establish standards, governance practices, methods, templates, or playbooks that improve consistency and maturity across teams.
* Ability to influence senior stakeholders and cross-functional partners while balancing business outcomes, risk, feasibility, scalability, and user impact.
* Strong analytical skills and ability to interpret product usage, adoption, funnel, and performance metrics.
* Working knowledge of Excel, SQL, BI tools, product analytics tools, or data visualization platforms.
* Ability to define product metrics, document assumptions, validate data, and explain limitations.
* Product mindset with the ability to connect user behavior to experience, process, and business outcomes.
* Strong communication skills for translating analysis into actionable product recommendations.
* Ability to partner with product owners, business analysts, change managers, and technical teams.
* Foundational AI literacy for product insight generation, feedback analysis, narrative drafting, and quality checks using approved tools.

**Nice To Have Skills**

* Experience advising executive or senior leadership audiences on complex workforce, HR, analytics, product, technology, process, or transformation decisions.
* Experience developing capability models, roadmaps, governance frameworks, maturity assessments, standards, or enterprise playbooks.
* Experience shaping responsible AI adoption, data governance, analytics modernization, automation strategy, or AI-enabled workforce readiness practices.
* Experience with HR systems, employee experience platforms, service portals, workflow tools, analytics products, or automation products.
* Exposure to product analytics tools such as Pendo, Amplitude, Mixpanel, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, or in-product telemetry.
* Experience with experimentation, A/B testing, release measurement, user research, or voice-of-customer analysis.
* Experience with Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Python, R, or statistical analysis tools.
* Prior experience in healthcare, shared services, HR operations, or regulated environments.
* Exposure to Agile product delivery, Jira, Confluence, product roadmaps, or backlog prioritization.
* Experience using AI to summarize feedback, generate hypotheses, or support product analytics workflows.

**Licenses, Certifications & Training**

* Preferred: role-relevant certification, analytics platform training, data governance training, or Agile delivery training, as applicable.
* Preferred: Responsible AI, data privacy, data security, or HR data handling training.

**Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, Behaviors**

* Demonstrates curiosity, ownership, and sound judgment when working with HR data, systems, processes, and stakeholders.
* Communicates status, assumptions, risks, and limitations clearly without overstating what the data, process, or technology can support.
* Works collaboratively across HR, technology, analytics, product, operations, and transformation partners in a matrixed environment.
* Protects confidential HR and workforce information and follows internal privacy, security, data governance, and compliance expectations.
* Uses AI tools with professional skepticism, validates AI-assisted outputs, avoids entering restricted data into unapproved tools, and escalates AI or data risks appropriately.
* Maintains documentation discipline, change awareness, customer focus, and continuous improvement mindset while balancing multiple priorities.

* Experience in interpreting advanced measurement metrics (incrementality, MMM).

* Comprehensive understanding of Google advertising platforms and competitive landscape.
* Proficiency in statistical analysis, A/B testing, and SQL.
* Proven ability to drive large work streams or transformations.

**About The Job**
Businesses of all shapes and sizes rely on Google’s unparalleled advertising solutions to help them grow in today's dynamic marketing environment. You bring a passion for sales, knowledge of online media, and commitment to maximize customer success. You act like an owner, move with velocity through change, finding innovative and strategic ways to consistently deliver extraordinary and incremental outcomes for both Google and your customers. You build trusted relationships with customers, uncovering their business needs and translating them into powerful solutions to achieve their most ambitious goals. You achieve as a team with sellers, shape the future of advertising in the AI-era, and make a real impact on the millions of companies and billions of users that trust Google with their most important goals.
  
  
Google creates products and services that make the world a better place, and gTech’s role is to help bring them to life. Our teams of trusted advisors support customers globally. Our solutions are rooted in our technical skill, product expertise, and a thorough understanding of our customers’ complex needs. Whether the answer is a bespoke solution to solve a unique problem, or a new tool that can scale across Google, everything we do aims to ensure our customers benefit from the full potential of Google products.
  
  
To learn more about gTech, check out our video .
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Act as the primary expert and be the central point of contact for clients for scaled implementation and execution for all Google measurement products.
* Perform diagnostic and solution implementation and assess client measurement needs, identify gaps in their current strategies, and implement effective solutions.
* Design and execute measurement strategies including design and execution of various measurement tests and studies, such as A/B experiments, brand lift studies, and incrementality studies, to provide actionable insights and recommendations.
* Drive industrialization works to unlock super-scale including initiatives to componentize and templatize complex measurement workflows leveraging AI prompts, automation and cross-functional partnerships to reduce turnaround times and improve test yield.
* Act as a strategic, cross-functional problem solver through active collaboration with both internal and external teams, ensure seamless project delivery and client satisfaction.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. title: Analyst I - Business Insights
description:
**General Position Information**
Reports directly to (Title): Manager, Advanced Analytics and Data Science
  
  
Matrix reports to (Title): As applicable based on HR Transformation & Analytics portfolio, platform, product, or functional alignment
  
  
Direct Reports: Individual contributor; may mentor or provide work direction to less experienced team members
  
  
Created / Last Revised: -
  
  
Job Code: -
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Analyst I - Business Insights leads higher-complexity work within the Human Resources Group (HRG), owning major deliverables, improving delivery quality, and translating business, data, technology, product, or process needs into reliable outcomes. This role operates with greater independence than the unprefixed level and is expected to lead workstreams, resolve ambiguity, mentor peers, and manage stakeholder expectations across HR, analytics, technology, operations, and transformation partners.
  
  
The Analyst I - Business Insights supports HRG by turning HR, workforce, operational, product, and transformation data into clear insights, narratives, and recommended actions. This role partners with HR leaders, analytics teams, business stakeholders, product owners, process teams, and reporting partners to interpret trends, visualize data in a compelling way, identify risks and opportunities, and prepare insight materials for business reviews and decision-making.
  
  
The role bridges analytics and business context. It is responsible for asking the right questions, validating data interpretations, running statistical models, developing executive-ready insight summaries, and helping stakeholders understand what is happening, why it matters, and what actions should be considered.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Senior-Level Ownership & Delivery Leadership**

* Lead complex deliverables, workstreams, analyses, designs, builds, or implementation activities with limited oversight.
* Translate ambiguous stakeholder needs into clear scope, success measures, requirements, plans, technical outputs, or recommendations.
* Review deliverables for accuracy, usability, governance alignment, stakeholder readiness, and business value before release or handoff.
* Mentor less experienced team members by sharing standards, reviewing work, and reinforcing documentation, testing, and delivery discipline.
* Identify delivery risks, data or process limitations, technical dependencies, and stakeholder alignment issues early and recommend practical mitigation actions.
* Hypothesis testing, statistical analysis, data storytelling, and interpretation of findings

**Insight Development & Business Interpretation**

* Analyze workforce, HR operations, transformation, product, and service data to identify patterns, root causes, risks, opportunities, and recommended actions.
* Develop insight narratives, business review materials, and executive summaries that translate data into practical decisions.
* Connect quantitative findings with qualitative inputs such as stakeholder feedback, operational context, process changes, and adoption signals.

**Performance Monitoring & Decision Support**

* Support recurring business reviews, leadership updates, metric reviews, and portfolio performance discussions.
* Track performance against goals, baselines, service levels, adoption targets, and transformation outcomes.
* Highlight material changes, emerging trends, and data limitations that require leadership attention or deeper analysis.

**Stakeholder Partnership & Framing**

* Work with business stakeholders to clarify the decision being supported, define the business question, and determine the most relevant metrics or evidence.
* Partner with reporting analysts, BI developers, data analysts, product analysts, and data owners to validate definitions, sources, and analysis outputs.
* Prepare presentations, briefing materials, storylines, and follow-up analysis for cross-functional audiences.

**AI-Enabled Insight Generation**

* Use approved AI tools to support hypothesis generation, pattern exploration, meeting synthesis, draft narratives, and alternative ways to explain findings.
* Validate AI-assisted summaries, avoid unsupported conclusions, and ensure recommendations are grounded in approved data and business context.
* Identify opportunities to improve insight speed, consistency, and accessibility through AI-assisted analytics workflows.

**AI Preparedness Expectations**

* Applies approved AI tools to accelerate complex deliverables, documentation, quality review, analysis, code, design, workflow support, or stakeholder materials while validating outputs before use.
* Identifies appropriate AI augmentation opportunities within assigned workstreams and helps teammates adopt safe, practical, and repeatable AI-enabled practices.
* Reviews AI-assisted outputs for accuracy, bias, completeness, privacy risk, governance alignment, and business context before release or recommendation.
* Builds deeper capability in AI-enabled HR analytics, workflow automation, decision support, and human-in-the-loop review over the next three years.
* Uses AI to accelerate synthesis, hypothesis generation, narrative drafting, and stakeholder-ready summaries without substituting AI output for judgment.
* Can evaluate whether AI-assisted conclusions are supported by source data, business context, and approved metric definitions.
* Builds capability in AI-assisted data storytelling, augmented analytics, responsible AI interpretation, and decision intelligence.

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Statistics, Engineering, Economics, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered.
* Typically 3+ years of experience in a related environment.
* Experience leading a defined workstream, analysis, product, technical deliverable, process improvement, reporting solution, or change initiative with cross-functional stakeholders.
* Experience reviewing deliverables, validating outputs, managing dependencies, and communicating risks or recommendations to managers, senior managers, or directors.
* Experience mentoring others, improving team standards, or contributing to repeatable methods, documentation, templates, or quality practices.
* Experience analyzing business, HR, workforce, operations, product, or transformation data and preparing insights for stakeholders.
* Experience creating summaries, presentations, scorecards, or business review materials that explain performance trends and actions.
* Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders to clarify business questions and translate analysis into recommendations.

**Must Have Skills**

* Ability to independently lead complex workstreams or deliverables from intake through execution, validation, and stakeholder communication.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to clarify expectations, manage dependencies, communicate risks, and influence decisions without direct authority.
* Demonstrated ability to review work for quality, accuracy, business relevance, data sensitivity, and operational readiness.
* Ability to mentor peers or junior team members and reinforce standards, documentation practices, and repeatable delivery methods.
* Strong statistical and critical-thinking skills, including the ability to move from data observations to business implications.
* Ability to synthesize complex information into clear storylines, executive summaries, and recommended actions.
* Working knowledge of Excel, PowerPoint, and at least one reporting, dashboarding, or analytics tool.
* Comfort interpreting HR, workforce, operational, product, or transformation metrics and explaining data limitations.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for both analytical and non-technical audiences.
* Ability to manage recurring deliverables and ad hoc requests with strong attention to detail.
* Foundational AI literacy for insight drafting, summarization, pattern exploration, and quality checks using approved tools.

**Nice To Have Skills**

* Experience serving as a subject matter expert, workstream lead, or delivery lead in HR, analytics, technology, transformation, shared services, or a regulated environment.
* Experience creating reusable templates, standards, training materials, quality checklists, or enablement content for team use.
* Experience applying approved AI tools to improve productivity, documentation quality, analysis, engineering, design, or stakeholder communication.
* Experience with HR analytics, workforce planning, talent analytics, employee listening, HR operations, shared services, or transformation reporting.
* Exposure to Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Python, R, or statistical analysis tools.
* Experience supporting executive business reviews, leadership scorecards, OKRs, or transformation value tracking.
* Prior experience in healthcare, shared services, global capability centers, or regulated environments.
* Knowledge of change adoption, product adoption, operational excellence, or process improvement metrics.
* Exposure to storytelling with data, visual communication, design thinking, or consulting-style presentation development.
* Experience using AI tools for meeting synthesis, insight brainstorming, narrative development, or research support.

**Licenses, Certifications & Training**

* Preferred: role-relevant certification, analytics platform training, data governance training, or Agile delivery training, as applicable.
* Preferred: Responsible AI, data privacy, data security, or HR data handling training.

**Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, Behaviors**

* Demonstrates curiosity, ownership, and sound judgment when working with HR data, systems, processes, and stakeholders.
* Communicates status, assumptions, risks, and limitations clearly without overstating what the data, process, or technology can support.
* Works collaboratively across HR, technology, analytics, product, operations, and transformation partners in a matrixed environment.
* Protects confidential HR and workforce information and follows internal privacy, security, data governance, and compliance expectations.
* Uses AI tools with professional skepticism, validates AI-assisted outputs, avoids entering restricted data into unapproved tools, and escalates AI or data risks appropriately.
* Maintains documentation discipline, change awareness, customer focus, and continuous improvement mindset while balancing multiple priorities.

title: UX Designer
description:
**About Reputation**
Reputation, founded in Silicon Valley in 2013, is the industry's sole platform that uses an AI-powered product stack to help companies measure, manage, and scale their real-time reputation performance everywhere, effectively functioning as a business's eyes and ears across all customer feedback channels to uncover predictive insights. This market leadership is reinforced by significant funding from top-tier firms like Bessemer Venture Partner, Kleiner Perkins, and Marlin Equity Partners, driving substantial annual recurring revenue from Global Fortune 1000 companies, major automotive OEMs, healthcare systems, and top property management firms, with trust from over 250 partners including Google and Meta. Recognized recently as America’s Greatest Midsized Workplaces by Newsweek which rewards excellence and career development, and attracts player-coaches, team-oriented collaborators, and individuals who value perseverance and hustle.
  
  
**Your Role At Reputation**
We’re looking for a talented and passionate UX/Product Designer who thrives on tackling complex problems and crafting seamless, elegant user experiences. User experience is at the forefront of how we design intuitive, innovative, and beautiful products that people love. This role will focus on contributing to the design and expansion of our product platform, collaborating cross-functionally, and delivering impactful solutions. You will have the opportunity to work closely with customers and internal teams to see your designs come to life and make a meaningful impact for our customers and their businesses.
  
  
**How You’ll Shape The Experience**

* Collaborate early with cross-functional teams including product management, engineering, customer success, and implementation/managed services to ensure UX design integration into the product lifecycle is technically feasible and meets design standards.
* Work closely with other UX team members and leadership to provide consistent experiences while simplifying complex user flows.
* Understanding of WCAG 2.2 accessibility requirements for web and mobile.
* Conduct user research with internal teams and customers, analyze feedback, and translate insights into actionable design solutions.
* Create wireframes, prototypes, user flows, and high-fidelity designs for adaptive web and mobile platforms.
* Support the development and maintenance of the design system to ensure consistency across products and functions.
* Advocate for user-centered design principles and contribute to usability testing and iteration cycles.
* Partner with product managers and developers to ensure accurate implementation of design specifications.
* Stay updated on industry trends, tools, and best practices to bring innovative ideas to the UX Team.

**The Skills That Set You Apart**

* Bachelor’s degree in UX Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Graphic Design, or a related field or 3-4 years of equivalent design experience.
* Understanding of the application of AI tools in design processes (i.e., skills, agentic AI, generative AI, Figma Agents, etc.)
* Understanding of software development life cycles
* 2+ years of experience in UX design for enterprise web and mobile applications, SaaS, and B2C or B2B
* Some experience designing for data analytics and data visualization.
* Strong interaction design skills and a solid understanding of user-centered design principles and patterns.
* Experience in conducting and analyzing user research.
* Understanding of Design Thinking processes and their implementation into engineering and product priorities.
* Proficiency in design/prototyping tools like Figma, Sketch, or Adobe XD.
* Experience designing for responsive web applications and mobile/tablet platforms.
* Excellent analytical skills.
* Ability to communicate design concepts effectively across different audiences.
* A collaborative spirit in working with product/engineering teams as well as other designers.
* Experience working within agile development teams.
* Self-motivated, detail-oriented, creative, and eager to collaborate in a team environment.

**Where You’ll Connect & Collaborate**

* Your main HQ is our Hyderabad, Telangana office, but we know great work can happen anywhere. You’ll have the flexibility of a hybrid schedule, joining us in person on Tuesdays and Wednesdays (subject to change) and working from home the rest of the week.

**Our Benefits & Perks**
We believe our people deserve to feel supported, valued, and rewarded both in and out of work. That’s why we offer a generous and thoughtfully designed benefits package, including:
  
  

* Health Insurance & Wellness Benefits: Group Health Insurance: Medical Insurance with floater policy of up to Rs 10,00,000 for employee + spouse + 2 dependent children + 2 parents / parent-in-laws
* Maternity Benefits: Medical insurance up to 75,000 INR, 26 weeks of leave for birth, adoption or surrogacy
* Life Insurance: Insurance at 3x annual cost to the company (Term Insurance, GPA)
* Accident/Disability Insurance: Insured at 3x base salary for permanent total disability, permanent partial disability and temporary total disability (GPA)
* OPD: As part of your health benefits, Employees are entitled to an annual OPD allowance of ₹7,500. This can be used for doctor consultations, diagnostic tests, and prescribed medications. The benefit is applicable to both the employee and eligible dependents and should be claimed within a month's time.
* AHC: All employees are eligible for one complimentary Annual Health Check each year. Employees may also extend this benefit to their dependents, they can avail the same package at the specially negotiated rates, payable by the employee.

**Leaves**

* Company Holidays: 10 paid holidays per year (see annual Holiday Calendar)
* Casual/Sick Leave: 12 days per year (pro-rated)
* Earned Leave: 2 days per month (pro-rated)
* Extended Company Holidays: 4 additional paid days off
* Maternity Leave: 6 months
* Paternity Leave: 10 working days
* Bereavement Leave: 10 working days

**Car Lease**

* Reputation is offering a Car Lease Program that allows employees to lease a car with no upfront cost or down payment. They benefit from a fixed monthly lease rental and 20-30% tax savings.
